Diana.attackTypeReason: Diana uses basic melee sword attacks and must dive directly into enemies to execute her full combo and deal the majority of her damage.
Diana.pokeReason: As a melee diver, Diana relies on engaging directly into fights rather than damaging enemies safely from range.

Gragas.attackTypeReason: Gragas must stand in close proximity to targets to land his empowered basic attacks and Body Slam.
Gragas.pokeReason: As a melee champion, Gragas relies on engaging and bursting targets rather than executing a true poke playstyle.

Kai'Sa.attackTypeReason: Kai'Sa is a marksman who basic attacks from range to deal her primary damage.
Kai'Sa.pokeReason: An AP-focused build relies on her evolved Void Seeker to deal massive long-range damage with a heavy cooldown refund on hit.

Kassadin.attackTypeReason: Kassadin must blink directly onto enemies with Riftwalk to deal his primary damage, requiring him to fight in melee range.
Kassadin.pokeReason: As a melee assassin who relies on all-in commits, Kassadin lacks the repeatable safe long-range damage required for a poke build.

Lillia.attackTypeReason: Lillia delivers medium-range basic attacks from a distance rather than standing directly on top of targets.
Lillia.pokeReason: Lillia relies on close-range skirmishing with her Q and movement speed rather than safe, repeatable long-range poke damage.

Lux.attackTypeReason: Lux uses ranged basic attacks and abilities, allowing her to deal damage from a safe distance without standing near targets.
Lux.pokeReason: Her long-range abilities, particularly Lucent Singularity, allow her to safely deal repeatable damage to enemies before a fight starts.

Nilah.attackTypeReason: Nilah uses a whip-blade and must stand in close melee range to execute her combos and deal sustained damage.
Nilah.pokeReason: Nilah is an all-in skirmisher who relies on entering close combat rather than dealing safe, repeatable damage from range.

Thresh.attackTypeReason: Thresh attacks at a moderate range using his chain whip, allowing him to deal basic attack damage from a distance without standing directly next to targets.
Thresh.pokeReason: Thresh's kit relies on high-cooldown engage abilities and crowd control rather than safe, repeatable long-range damage.

Akali.attackTypeReason: Akali relies on melee basic attacks empowered by her passive and must close the distance to deliver her main damage combo.
Akali.pokeReason: As a melee assassin, Akali lacks safe long-range abilities to repeatedly harass enemies before engaging in a fight.

Evelynn.attackTypeReason: Evelynn relies on melee basic attacks and close-range ability combos to deal damage and execute targets.
Evelynn.pokeReason: Evelynn is a melee AP assassin focused on stealth flanks and close-range burst damage, lacking the safe long-range tools needed to poke.

Katarina.attackTypeReason: Katarina must jump directly onto enemies and stay in melee range to pick up daggers and channel her ultimate.
Katarina.pokeReason: As a melee assassin, Katarina must commit into close quarters to execute her combos rather than dealing safe, repeatable damage from a distance.

Rakan.attackTypeReason: Rakan uses ranged cape strikes for his basic attacks, allowing him to damage targets from just outside melee range.
Rakan.pokeReason: Rakan functions primarily as a short-range engage support rather than a long-range poke champion.

Rumble.attackTypeReason: Rumble must stand in close melee range to land basic attacks and maximize damage with his Flamespitter.
Rumble.pokeReason: As a melee champion, Rumble is ineligible for a poke playstyle.

Vladimir.attackTypeReason: Vladimir attacks enemies from a distance with blood-based basic attacks.
Vladimir.pokeReason: Vladimir operates as a mid-range battlemage who relies on sustain and teamfight all-ins rather than long-range pre-fight poke.
